scientific_intent.scientific_task: Bayesian-network structure scoring and ordered structure search
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: K2 uniform-state-prior Dirichlet-multinomial local marginal scores over every zero-to-four-parent set, ordered parent optimization, and 100-order Metropolis search with top unique scored graphs.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: A bounded discrete probabilistic graphical-model structure-learning operator on synthesized binary data; no causal-discovery, posterior-calibration or real-data claim.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Every local score against independent contingency histograms and Float64 log-factorials with a per-point Float32/table error envelope; every selected parent set attains the actual within-order local maximum; full DAG/score/feedback/top-population certificates.
scientific_intent.support_boundary: Nine nodes projected from the original 45-column/600-row synthesized data, plus mixed binary and constant controls. Two complete GPU bodies, all parent sets through four parents and full 100-order host feedback. Original 45-node CLI and global DAG optimality are unverified. Unpopulated top slots are retained, not certified as scored graphs.
scientific_intent.reference_condition: Conditional owned corrected-native reference: log(0!) initialization, parent-code decoding, zero-padding interpretation and paired score/index argmax. Original and failed intermediate sources/captures remain preserved.
